audit_metadata.audit_title: Healthcare CDSS Portable, Secure, Clinically Grounded Final Release Gate
audit_metadata.environment: Windows 11 / PowerShell 7+ / Node v24 / Python 3.12 / MySQL 8.0

screenshots.title: Unified Login Screen in Light Mode
screenshots.description: Visual aesthetics in clean medical green/white palette with role selection tabs (Patient, Doctor, Receptionist), password visibility toggle, and credential verification.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Rendered crisp typography, intuitive role switcher, and accessible password input.

screenshots.title: Unified Login Screen in Dark Mode
screenshots.description: High-contrast dark theme mode with muted borders, slate backgrounds, and green accent buttons.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Proper WCAG AA color contrast maintained; dark mode toggle operates cleanly.

screenshots.title: Authenticated Patient Dashboard (Aarav Patil)
screenshots.description: Patient home dashboard displaying upcoming consultations, active prescriptions, and discharge status summary.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Authenticated session established via JWT; patient health profile and active records displayed.

screenshots.title: Authentication Rejection on Invalid Credentials
screenshots.description: Negative security test: entering incorrect password triggers visible red error banner and denies token issuance.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Error toast displayed: 'Invalid email or password'. Zero session state established.

screenshots.title: Patient Self-Registration & DPDP Consent
screenshots.description: Public registration interface enforcing client/server email formatting, phone validation, password length, and DPDP Act consent.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Validates inputs in real-time; restricts public self-registration strictly to patient accounts.

screenshots.title: Forgot Password Request & Anti-Enumeration Feedback
screenshots.description: Forgot password submission generating cryptographically secure SHA-256 token with anti-enumeration response and prototype recovery link.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Anti-enumeration message displayed; prototype link provided for local evaluation.

screenshots.title: Password Reset Form with Token Validation
screenshots.description: Token verification endpoint validates single-use token on mount and allows authorized credential update.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Token validated as active; password update enforced and token consumed against replay.

screenshots.title: Clinician Dashboard & Daily Schedule
screenshots.description: Doctor portal dashboard displaying OPD patient schedule, consultation navigation, and clinical safety gates.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Doctor session authenticated with physician licensing metadata and active patient roster.

screenshots.title: Standardized Approved Physician Directory
screenshots.description: Physician search interface filtering exclusively approved clinical staff (Dr. Rahul Sharma, Dr. Priya Nair, Dr. Elena Vance, Dr. Kavita Verma).
screenshots.observed_behavior: Zero duplicate or test artifact physicians rendered; verified clinical specialties and chamber details.

screenshots.title: Synthea Patient Dossier (Terrilyn Murphy)
screenshots.description: Truthful empty state rendering for synthetic patient: shows zero active prescriptions and zero discharge summaries.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Truthful rendering without invented care or hallucinated treatments.

screenshots.title: Synthea Documented Allergies & Medical History
screenshots.description: Renders 25 active clinical conditions and 10 documented allergies (Aspirin, Latex, Bee venom, Peanuts) from FHIR bundle.
screenshots.observed_behavior: All 10 allergies cleanly mapped from FHIR AllergyIntolerance resources with severity badges.

screenshots.title: Truthful Unknown State for Patient without Documented Allergies
screenshots.description: Clinical safety invariant: patients without AllergyIntolerance resources show 'No Known Allergies Recorded (Verify with Patient)'.
screenshots.observed_behavior: System does not infer absence of allergies means negative allergy finding; alerts clinician to verify.

screenshots.title: Separation of Historical Requests from Active Treatment
screenshots.description: EHR displays historical Synthea MedicationRequests in medical history without converting them to active prescriptions.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Zero legacy invented prescriptions; historical records accurately timestamped.

screenshots.title: Clinician Prescription Composer & Validation
screenshots.description: Doctor authors prescription with structured medication name, dose, frequency, and duration inputs.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Form validation enforces required dosing fields prior to triggering safety screening.

screenshots.title: Non-Overridable Allergy Hard Stop (HTTP 422)
screenshots.description: Proposing Aspirin 81mg to Terrilyn Murphy triggers non-overridable allergy contraindication (cannot_override: true).
screenshots.observed_behavior: Save Prescription button locked; override checkbox disabled with red warning banner.

screenshots.title: Severe Drug-Drug Interaction Warning & Safer Alternatives
screenshots.description: Proposing Atorvastatin alongside active Clarithromycin detects CYP3A4 myopathy interaction (RUL-INT-007) and offers Rosuvastatin.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Presents evidence-backed statin alternatives; selecting alternative resets dosing parameters.

screenshots.title: Clinician-Approved Prescription & Attested PDF
screenshots.description: Prescription saved with cryptographic hash and downloadable PDF with physician attestation.
screenshots.observed_behavior: PDFKit streams binary PDF; patient BOLA isolation prevents unauthorized cross-patient downloads.

screenshots.title: Doctor Discharge Directive Authoring
screenshots.description: Clinician authors structured discharge summary, medication timing, diet, wound care, and follow-up plan.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Discharge record persisted in MySQL database and linked to patient episode.

screenshots.title: Patient Grounded Post-Discharge Recovery Guidance
screenshots.description: Patient asks 'What care should I take?' and receives answer strictly grounded in their saved discharge plan with hospital citation.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Grounded response returned with 'Authorized Hospital Discharge Care Plan' citation badge.

screenshots.title: Honest Absence Disclosure for Patient without Discharge Plan
screenshots.description: Patient without discharge summary asks recovery question; system honestly discloses absence with 0 citations.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Discloses absence honestly without substituting generic advice or inventing medical instructions.

screenshots.title: General Medical Reference Query with DailyMed Citations
screenshots.description: Patient asks general drug question 'What is Metformin used for?' and receives frozen RAG response with 3 DailyMed SPL citations.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Routed to frozen hybrid RAG pipeline; answer supported by retrieved FDA DailyMed SPL evidence.

screenshots.title: Fail-Closed Abstention on Unsupported Entity
screenshots.description: Submitting unindexed or unsupported chemical query triggers fail-closed policy abstention with clinical disclaimer.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Safely abstained without fabricating dosage or clinical instructions.

screenshots.title: Receptionist Appointment Queue & Scheduling Roster
screenshots.description: Receptionist dashboard displaying consultation schedule, physician assignments, and status transition actions.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Full consultation schedule displayed with status filters and booking actions.

screenshots.title: Localized Indic Interface in Hindi
screenshots.description: Patient interface rendered in Hindi with native clinical terminology and RTL/LTR layout fidelity.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Discharge guidance and health assistant queries accurately localized in Hindi.

screenshots.title: Mobile Responsive Viewport Layout
screenshots.description: Evaluation of patient portal on mobile form factor with collapsible navigation drawer and responsive cards.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Clean responsive rendering with zero horizontal overflow or clipping.

screenshots.title: Session Termination & Protected Route Rejection
screenshots.description: Logging out cleanses session state; attempting to access `/patient/dashboard` redirects to `/login`.
screenshots.observed_behavior: JWT token removed from localStorage; unauthorized route access immediately blocked.

screenshots.title: Appointment Reschedule Modal & Operating Hours Guidance
screenshots.description: Receptionist opens Reschedule modal on confirmed appointment; modal displays clinic operating hours guidance (09:00 - 17:00, Mon-Sat).
screenshots.observed_behavior: Modal renders with date and time pickers, operating hours alert, and current schedule metadata.

screenshots.title: Receptionist Queue with Reschedule Actions
screenshots.description: Receptionist consultation schedule displays appointment cards with 'Reschedule' action trigger on active bookings.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Appointments queue renders all statuses; Reschedule action cleanly triggers modal.

screenshots.title: Consultation Booking Modal with Interval Validation
screenshots.description: Booking modal allows patient and physician selection with 30-minute standard slot validation.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Patient and physician selectors populate from database; enforces required fields.

screenshots.title: Persisted Consultation Booking with Real-Time Conflict Detection
screenshots.description: Successful booking persists to database; attempting overlapping slot triggers real-time HTTP 409 Conflict rejection.
screenshots.observed_behavior: Successfully schedules valid appointment; detects doctor and patient time slot overlaps and prevents double-booking.
